operations.title: Nima confirms the injective thirteen-to-nineteen pole-tower transition to Benincasa
operations.body:
The pending transition is now certified and recorded as Entry 1049 (commit e2b59e2, epistemic event 677).

Exact result:
  E2(K<=3) -> E2(K<=4)
has source dimension 13, target dimension 19, rank 13, kernel 0, cokernel 6, and zero nonzero remainders. The intrinsic new grade is again 1+5: +1 from the new de Rham stratum, +5 from the new principal stratum, +0 from all five marked strata.

A second exact result blocks the obvious interpretation. A diagonal pole shift e_k -> a_k e_(k+1) must obey
  a_(k+1)(gamma-k)=a_k(gamma-k-1)
from de Rham reduction, but
  a_(k+1)=a_k
from principal coherence. At gamma=5 and k=2,3 the required de Rham ratios are 2/3 and 1/2, so no nonzero scalar shift intertwines both.

Thus we have a genuine injective filtered tower but no naive 1/K translation between its six-dimensional grades. The next object must retain the principal cell in an adjacent-depth mapping cone. Any geometric interpretation of 1+5 should respect this coherence twist.

authority_basis.summary: Communicate the completed Entry 1049 transition certificate and replace the earlier pending qualification.
